theme_archetype.rationale: Blends the approachable, friendly, optimistic vibe needed for school students (Classes 6-10) with the cinematic, deep, premium feel of an AI-native consumer app. Avoids feeling like a standard LMS or enterprise tool.

design_philosophy.simplicity: Apple-level simplicity, minimal cognitive load, progressive disclosure.
design_philosophy.precision: Linear-level precision, perfect alignment, high-quality typography.
design_philosophy.delight: Arc Browser-level delightful interactions, micro-animations everywhere.
design_philosophy.friendliness: Duolingo-level approachability, but mature enough for teens.
design_philosophy.aesthetic: Stripe-level premium gradients, 20-28px rounded corners, glassmorphism, soft layering.

nova_orb_states.idle: Soft breathing animation (scale 1 to 1.05), slow rotation, gentle gradient shift (Indigo to Sky Blue).
nova_orb_states.listening: Dynamic voice wave outer rings responding to audio input, pulsing Emerald Green.
nova_orb_states.processing: Rapid inner spinning animation, shrinking slightly, glowing deeply.
nova_orb_states.celebrating: Burst of Warm Yellow and Emerald particles, scale pops to 1.2.

cards.base: Surface background, lg border radius (28px), 1px subtle border, soft premium shadow.
cards.glass: Requires expo-blur BlurView. surface_glass tint, intense blur radius, used for floating UI elements over Nova.

chips.style: Pill-shaped (radius full), semi-transparent background (primary_soft or secondary_soft), heavily legible text. Used for conversation starters.

buttons.primary: Emerald Green background, bold white text, scale down slightly on press (React Native Reanimated withSpring).
buttons.voice_mic: Large floating action button, heavily shadowed, always accessible at bottom center.

mission_cards.style: Asymmetric bento layout. Features a 3D icon/illustration on one side, clean progress indicator (animated ring) on the other. Backgrounds subtly tinted with accent colors.

animations.engine: React Native Reanimated & expo-blur for glass effects.
animations.page_transitions: Smooth fade and slide up, similar to iOS native modal presentations.
animations.interactions: All touchable elements must have a spring-based scale-down effect on pressIn.
animations.celebration: Use Lottie/Rive for confetti when daily missions are completed. Restrict to major milestones to maintain premium feel.

icons_and_illustrations.illustration_style: High-quality 3D minimalist or modern flat, avoiding childish vectors. Incorporate abstract representations of growth (plants, seeds) and technology.

media_urls.description: Abstract glowing light orb/bubbles. Use as the static fallback or background for the Nova AI mentor.
Computer generated circular technology object. Use during AI 'thinking' or 'processing' states.
Minimalist 3D growing plant sprout. Central visual for the Growth Dashboard and completed missions.
Abstract blue waves of glowing particles. Use as background for the 'Career Explorer - AI/Tech' card.
Young student working on modern tech. Use in the 'Day in the Life' career detail views.

instructions_to_main_agent: TECH STACK RULE: Build using React Native (Expo). Do NOT use web-based Tailwind or Shadcn/ui. Use StyleSheet or NativeWind. Write all code in .js files, NOT .tsx.
VOICE FIRST: The Home screen should NOT feel like a traditional menu. The 'Nova' AI character takes up the top 60% of the screen. Navigation and chips should float over the bottom.
GLASSMORPHISM: Use expo-blur for floating conversational UI cards (like Siri or Arc Search) overlaid on top of the Nova character.
ANIMATIONS: Use React Native Reanimated. Every button press must have a subtle scale animation. Nova must have a continuous floating/breathing animation (translateY and scale).
TESTING: Apply testID attribute to all interactive elements instead of data-testid (since it is React Native). Use descriptive kebab-case names.
NO LOREUM IPSUM: Write real conversational copy for the AI. 'Hi, I'm Nova. Ready to grow your skills today?'
DARK MODE: Ensure dynamic color token usage so the app seamlessly switches between the light and dark palettes.
